headlines.headline: NC State taps Justin Gainey as new coach while Texas Tech eligibility case heads to court
headlines.detail: NC State hired longtime Rick Barnes assistant Justin Gainey after Will Wade left for LSU; a court hearing today over Texas Tech guard Darrion Williams' eligibility looms as first official practices open nationwide.

headlines.headline: Pistons hold line on Jalen Duren offer as Kings interest surfaces ahead of camp
headlines.detail: Detroit is still declining to raise its roughly $190M extension offer to Duren, who wants $200M+; the Kings have reportedly made an offer the Pistons have rebuffed with camp about two weeks out.

headlines.headline: Falcons name Penix starter for Week 3 as Bears' Caleb Williams goes week-to-week
headlines.detail: Atlanta confirmed Michael Penix Jr. starts vs. Green Bay; Chicago's Caleb Williams is week-to-week with a hamstring ahead of a Monday night game at Philadelphia; Washington's Jayden Daniels seeks outside opinions on his elbow with Marcus Mariota starting.

headlines.headline: Texas A&M craters to No. 23 after upset loss to Kentucky as Ole Miss surges to No. 4
headlines.detail: A&M fell 15 spots after an unranked Kentucky beat them 31-21; Ole Miss jumped to No. 4 behind a 32-24 win over Lane Kiffin's LSU; Texas held No. 1 with a 30-6 win over UTSA.
